title: WIP: image/docker: handle full blob response on bodyReader reconnect
body:
When a blob download is interrupted (`unexpected EOF`) and `bodyReader` retries with a Range header, some CDNs or registries may ignore the Range header and return the full blob with HTTP 200 instead of 206.

Previously this was treated as an error. Now the already-read bytes are discarded from the response body and reading continues from the correct offset, matching [containerd's behavior](https://github.com/containerd/containerd/blob/e6618451086f9656872427ee17f49433436e2a40/core/remotes/docker/resolver.go#L741-L770).

This addresses intermittent pull failures observed after the registry.k8s.io CDN migration to Fastly (https://github.com/kubernetes/registry.k8s.io/issues/333), where CRI-O and Podman users were affected while containerd was not.
